name: Ajanta Soya Limited
about: Ajanta Soya Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of vanaspati and refined oils in India. It offers edible vegetable oils, including soyabean, palm, sunflower, rice bran, mustard, groundnut, and cottonseed oil, as well as specialty fats. The company also provides bakery shortening for use in bakery products, such as biscuits, puffs, pastries, and other applications. It markets its products under the Dhruv, Anchal, Nutri-1992, ASL Pure, Parv, ASL Fine Fingers, and ASL brand names. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.
